The accepted native configuration named Keyrun 2015_NorthSea1991_12Jan16.eweaccdb differs materially from this port and is not available locally. The contextual 2018 management-plan application has 10 fleets, versus 11 in the deposited port; it is not interchangeable.

Article — No separate article-choice rationale is recorded.Model — The researcher selected this published North Sea 1991 Rpath snapshot on 14/10/2026 because its static mass-balance checks pass. Recorded limitations include its difference from the native EwE Key Run, source routing restrictions and loader departures. Numerical readiness and researcher approval were not established.

Source reconciliation and round-trip checks support the deposited Rpath port. Missing source inputs were completed only from deposited outputs: biomass for 8 groups, Q/B for 11 and EE for 61. Static source budgets balance, with five P/Q range warnings.The repaired shared loader retains published phytoplankton routing, explicit zero detritus-fate rows, source TL and catch. Four missing import-diet cells for nonfeeding groups use a documented structural-zero convention. No source parameters or diets were changed.Published fleet discards return 0.49945 t/km²/year to Discards (69). Accounting now includes their donor PPR once and separates internal returns from external removals. The former negative detritus coefficients and large PP-budget failure disappear under the stated runtime assumptions.Source departures and evidence

Static base state: 1991; the report's time-series calibration spans 1991–2013. Applying the port to 2019 catch is a 28-year transfer of the baseline food web, not a calibrated 2019 reconstruction. A future fixed allocation would need its own temporal justification.

With Egestion: WARN; no negative or nonfinite entries. rho_living = 0.22945; b = 0.91516. Detritus SPPR: DOM (67) = 5.5808, POM (68) = 7.1126, Discards (69) = 182.04. PP-budget relative gap = 5.18 × 10⁻¹⁴; high detritus cost and recycling sensitivity remain.All three runs use EE floor 0.1: a hypothetical external nonfishery sink of 1.9837 t/km²/year across eight living groups. Source BA remains zero; effective detritus stock residuals are DOM 152.69, POM 125.21 and Discards 0.003590 t/km²/year. This runtime closure and detritus EE = 1 convention are not observed accumulation or recovered native export. No diet normalization, pooling or open-detritus adjustment was used.

elements.text: Comparison of the two candidates

Recommend retaining ICES North Sea 1991 as the selected candidate for further validation. The repaired implementation now converges with finite, nonnegative results and a closed PP budget in all three methods, and its declared domain covers substantially more of LME_022 than Scotland. This supersedes the provisional Scotland preference based on the faulty ICES runtime. ICES still has material sensitivity warnings, runtime closure assumptions, no exact-model catch mapping and no recovered native Key Run database; it is not yet ready for an approved regional PPR estimate.
